name: Oracle Migration Assessment
description: Captures Oracle-specific dependencies, Oracle-to-PostgreSQL conversion readiness, migration constraints, validation, licensing and target decisions that cannot be determined from automated discovery alone.

sections.title: Oracle Workload, Scope & Target
sections.description: Identify the Oracle estate, application boundary, critical schemas and intended destination.

questions.text: Which Oracle databases, CDBs, PDBs and schemas are in scope for this wave?
Is the engagement database migration only, or does it include application and Oracle SQL syntax conversion?
Are multiple applications, customers or business units sharing this Oracle database?
Which applications, integrations and vendors depend on each in-scope database, and will they support the proposed target?
Describe release, batch, reporting, seasonal or interface schedules that constrain migration timing.
Who owns and can approve changes to application code, PL/SQL and database objects?
Which Oracle migration destination and target database version are being evaluated?
options: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Oracle Database on Azure Virtual Machines
Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Database

questions.text: Which workloads can modernize to PostgreSQL and which require Oracle Database@Azure or another Oracle destination?

sections.title: Oracle Assessment Readiness
sections.description: Confirm safe metadata collection, performance evidence and prerequisites for compatibility and sizing decisions.

questions.text: Who will run the Oracle assessment and information-gathering scripts and return the outputs?
Can the scripts run with a read-only account without changing objects, transactions, data or processes?
Has customer security reviewed what the scripts collect, where outputs are stored and how they are returned?
Are complete inventory, schema metadata and application dependency outputs available for all in-scope production and non-production databases?
Which AWR or Statspack reports are available, and do they cover representative peak periods for production and non-production?
Are target server count, consolidation model, compute, storage and cost sizing expected from the assessment?
Have required access, ports, Oracle client and TNS configuration, Java runtime, execution host and target database been prepared and tested?

sections.title: Oracle Features & Conversion
sections.description: Confirm whether discovered Oracle capabilities and schema or application code can be converted or replaced.

questions.text: Which discovered Oracle features are business-critical, removable or require replacement?
Describe external systems reached through database links, gateways, queues, directories or file access.
Which PL/SQL procedures, packages, functions and triggers require automated conversion versus manual redesign?
Are wrapped or encrypted packages, synonyms, directories or other objects without a direct target equivalent in scope?
Are schemas tightly coupled through cross-schema references or transactions and therefore required to migrate together?
Does application behavior depend on Oracle-specific SQL or session semantics?
questions.helpText: Examples include empty strings treated as NULL, Oracle DATE behavior, NLS settings, sequence behavior, quoted identifiers, hints or implicit type conversions.

questions.text: Describe exceptionally large tables, partitions, BLOBs, CLOBs or archival data that require a separate migration strategy.

sections.title: Migration Tooling & Continuity
sections.description: Select an approved workflow and confirm online or offline feasibility, connectivity and rollback prerequisites.

questions.text: Which migration workflow best fits the source, target and downtime requirements?
Which migration and conversion tools are approved or preferred?
What is the approval and licensing status for third-party tools, GitHub Copilot and Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI dependencies?
Must an AI capability be disabled or separately approved for assessment, schema conversion or data transfer?
Have source-to-target compatibility prerequisites been verified for the selected workflow?
questions.helpText: Check database version and patch level, character set, time-zone version, encryption, target restrictions and unsupported object types.
options: Not applicable to the selected workflow

questions.text: Has secure source-to-target connectivity and sustained migration throughput been tested from the execution host with representative data?
Can source schema and application changes be frozen during the final migration and validation window?
Describe the rollback method, reconciliation required before rollback and rollback decision triggers.
Is a source and target coexistence period required after cutover?

sections.title: Validation & Cutover Readiness
sections.description: Define the evidence, rehearsals and approvals required before production cutover.

questions.text: Which source-to-target validation checks are required for acceptance?
options: Date, time zone and character encoding checks

questions.text: Who owns data reconciliation and has authority to accept documented variances?
Have representative peak-load performance baselines and target acceptance thresholds been agreed?
options: Baselines captured but thresholds not agreed

questions.text: What is the status of the non-production proof of concept and production-scale migration rehearsal?
What is the production cutover target, go/no-go process and required maintenance window?
Who provides final business, application, database, security and operations sign-off for cutover?

sections.title: Licensing, Security & Operations
sections.description: Capture Oracle licensing, encryption, access, target controls and post-migration operating requirements.

questions.text: Which separately licensed Oracle options or management packs are currently used?
Are there Oracle Wallet, TDE, HSM or external key-management dependencies?
Describe required authentication integrations such as LDAP, Kerberos, proxy users or enterprise users.
Which Oracle security and audit controls must be preserved or replaced on the target?
Which target security controls are required before production?
Who will own backup, point-in-time recovery, patching, monitoring, incident response and performance tuning on the target?
What hypercare coverage is required after migration?
questions.helpText: The Factory service description uses five days of joint hypercare as its standard outcome.

questions.text: What criteria and approvals are required to decommission the source and terminate Oracle licenses or support?
